title: The level sets of the count of geometric connected fibre components are locally constructible
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a finitely presented morphism, the level sets of the function counting geometric connected components of the fibres are locally constructible. The proof reduces to the affine case, expresses the count of geometric connected components of a fibre as a condition on a finitely presented algebra after base change, and applies the constructibility criterion. As in the irreducible case, the encoding of the component count as a finite-presentation condition is the substantive step. Retained author proof at lines 8106-8129.
